comment: Sound catalogue of the radar. firmware/dragonradar/sounds.h is generated from this by the common tools/gen_sounds.mjs (each entry: name, tempo, notes in the melody format of sound.h: raw HZ:MS tones and R:MS rests, ~square / ~sine switches the waveform of the tones that follow). gain (0-100, percent of the user volume) and the beep block are read by tools/gen_radar.mjs (radar_assets.h), the preview and tools/preview/render_wav.mjs; the other fields are documentation. Reconstructed by ear from the anime's electronic 'pi' beeps; see docs/design.md.

synth.comment: How every renderer plays a tone (matches the ES8311 synth of sound.cpp): naive square or sine, amplitude ramped over rampMs at each change, level = 0.915 x (volume / 100)^2 of full scale. Raw HZ:MS tones are legato (no gap between them).

beep.comment: The radar beep repeats while at least one ball is known. Its interval depends on the distance d (metres) of the nearest ball, on a log scale: t = clamp((log10(farM) - log10(d)) / (log10(farM) - log10(nearM)), 0, 1); interval = maxIntervalMs + (minIntervalMs - maxIntervalMs) x t^curvePow. The distance is absolute, so zooming does not change the rhythm. The dots flash on every beep (radar.json blink). Crossing closeM plays ball_close once and crossing foundM plays ball_found once; each re-arms when the distance grows past threshold x rearmFactor.

sfx.name: power_on
sfx.es: Encendido: barrido que sube mientras se enciende la pantalla, un pip cuando aparece el marcador y un pip doble con la onda de escaneo
sfx.en: Power on: a rising sweep while the screen lights up, a pip when the marker appears and a double pip with the scan ring

sfx.name: radar_beep
sfx.es: El pitido del radar; se repite más rápido cuanto más cerca está la esfera
sfx.en: The radar beep; repeats faster the closer the nearest ball is

sfx.name: zoom_out
sfx.es: Botón de arriba: clic mecánico y un blip agudo al alejar la escala
sfx.en: Top button: a mechanical click and a high blip when zooming out

sfx.name: zoom_in
sfx.es: Acercar la escala: el mismo clic con un blip más grave
sfx.en: Zoom in: the same click with a lower blip

sfx.name: ball_close
sfx.es: Una esfera entra a menos de 30 m: tres pips rápidos
sfx.en: A ball comes within 30 m: three quick pips

sfx.name: ball_found
sfx.es: Esfera encontrada (a menos de 3 m): cuatro notas que suben
sfx.en: Ball found (within 3 m): four rising notes

sfx.name: power_off
sfx.es: Apagado: barrido que baja mientras se apaga la pantalla
sfx.en: Power off: a falling sweep while the screen goes dark
